title: iOS-26 Liquid Glass design-evolution
identity: warm-cream HELD — every fold is a token edit or additive fold, never a hue swap, never a clone

perimeterRim.distinctFrom: --glass-highlight (top-only inset 0 0.5px 0 0) — this is a four-edge full-perimeter ring
perimeterRim.rimAlpha: 0.18 light / 0.10 dark — decoration weight, below the legibility-reading threshold

propertySpecularRegs.home: tokens.css §11b, alongside the existing three regs (progress-crescendo, phase-tint-amount, ripple-radius)

rungSaturateParity.before: --glass-blur-quiet: blur(10px)  (bare blur, the only ladder rung without saturate)
rungSaturateParity.rationale: M1 — the lower ladder reads with the same saturation life as resting+ (Apple: Liquid Glass concentrates light, it does not desaturate)

contentAwareUnderShadow.note: vivid was sufficient over text — --glass-under-shadow-text NOT authored (no overfit fourth rung)

movingSpecular.recipe: radial-gradient(circle at var(--specular-x) var(--specular-y), …) over a mask-image, mix-blend-mode: screen, on a ::before pseudo (a light layer, not a second glass plate — no glass-on-glass)
movingSpecular.pointerSeam: consumer writes --mouse-x/--mouse-y; the rung maps them onto the typed --specular-x/y; intensity lifts on hover/active

guards.reducedMotionStatic: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce pins --specular-x/y to 50% + transition:none (static centred catch-light, warm-cream tint intact)
guards.varFallback: var(--specular-x, 50%) / var(--specular-y, 50%) — a centred catch-light paints without typed-property animation
guards.reducedTransparency: prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce → display:none (decoration without substrate when the surface goes opaque)

refractionGarnish.substrate: the blur base paints WITHOUT it; no url(#…) declaration leaks outside the @supports block
refractionGarnish.trigger: WebKit bug #245510 (not shipping), Firefox not shipping; reaches Baseline on Chromium today, fully on the WebKit fix

discipline.noGlassOnGlass: documented in dock/README.md + glass.css header — glass is the navigation/overlay band only; nested glass is a violation (read as flat tier instead)
discipline.springCrossRef: AV.W9 (dock motion / velocity continuity) + AV.W11 (slider) own the momentum-gated press squish — cross-referenced, not re-authored; the material half (rim/specular) + the spring half are one Liquid Glass behaviour

accessibility.aaFloors: tokens.css:332 (neutral-5 L40, AA 5.23:1/4.91:1) + :341 (neutral-6 L30, AA 7.79:1/7.31:1) byte-unchanged — the folds are glass-surface decoration, not text-color edits
accessibility.edgeLightAlphaCap: ≤ 0.25 (rim is decoration, must not eat legibility over a busy backdrop)

gate: proof:liquid-glass-tokens (born RED, greened) — registered local+ci in gates.mjs + package.json
